# Project Overview

This project is a pomodoro app, called "pomo", designed to help users manage
their time while focusing in a task using the Pomodoro technique. Users
should be able to start, pause and restart a timer. It will also provide visual and audio cues to enhance the user experience. The design should be minimalist and user-friendly.

## Folder structure

- `/src`: Contains the source code of the app

## Libraries and frameworks

- Latest Vue.js 3.x and TailwindCSS 4.x
- TypeScript
- Vite
- Vitest

## Coding standards

- Always use the most modern, best practices, clean, and maintainable code.
- Always follow and maintain the Clean Architecture principles for a front-end application
- Always use Vue's Composition API
- Try to use the SOLID principles as much as possible
- Use double-quotes for strings
- Use semicolons at the end of each statement

### Use cases for the pomodoro app MVP

- Start pomodoro
- Pause pomodoro
- Restart pomodoro
- Complete pomodoro

### Services for the pomodoro MVP

- TimerService
- NotificationService
